summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Shopping Cart with Real-Time Updates feature. All cart functionality working correctly: right-side slide-in Sheet sidebar, empty state with Browse Menu CTA, real-time subtotal updates, minimum-order warning banner ($15 min), undo toast via sonner on item removal, qty stepper (plus/minus), checkout navigation, and localStorage persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext.js: Correctly implements MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT=15, belowMinimum/amountToMinimum calculations, and sonner undo toast in removeItem
CartDrawer.js: Uses shadcn Sheet side='right' with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
App.js: Toaster positioned at bottom-right with richColors and closeButton
localStorage persistence working correctly with key 'culinary_cart'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 10 Shopping Cart features fully tested. Key features verified: (1) Cart sidebar slides in from right when item added, (2) Item displays with image, name, qty stepper (plus/minus), remove button (Trash2), and line total, (3) Qty plus/minus buttons update line total and subtotal in real-time, (4) Minus below 1 triggers removal, (5) Remove via trash shows sonner toast with Undo action - clicking Undo restores item, (6) Minimum order banner shows when subtotal < $15 with progress bar and disabled checkout button showing '$X more to checkout', (7) Banner disappears and checkout enables when subtotal >= $15, (8) Checkout button navigates to /checkout and closes sidebar, (9) Empty state shows 'Your cart is empty' with 'Browse Menu' CTA that navigates to /menu and closes sidebar, (10) Cart persists across page reload via localStorage key 'culinary_cart'. Smoke tests confirm Auth, Menu, and Admin flows still working. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED.
